overview: The Medford Community Development Board voted to recommend a zoning map amendment changing parcels on Boston Avenue and North Street from Industrial to Office 2. The board also received a presentation on draft materials for the city's Comprehensive Plan and elected board officers.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from the meeting held on January 5, 2022.

items.title: Public Hearing: Boston Avenue and North Street Rezoning
items.summary: The board held a public hearing and voted to recommend a zoning map amendment changing properties bounded by Boston Avenue, North Street, and the railroad tracks from Industrial to Office 2.

items.title: Comprehensive Plan Draft Presentation
items.summary: Consultants presented an update on draft recommendations and implementation strategies for Medford's citywide Comprehensive Plan.

items.title: Election of Board Officers
items.summary: The board elected David Blumberg as Chair, Jacqueline McPherson as Vice Chair, and Emily Hedeman as Clerk.
